Se localiza y neutraliza el comprobante duplicado de 1350 NOK en cuenta 7100
Se añade la línea de IVA faltante en cuenta 2710 para la base de 21900 NOK en cuenta 4500
Se corrige el importe en cuenta 7300 de 15800 NOK a 5850 NOK
El libro mayor de enero y febrero de 2026 queda ajustado con trazabilidad de los asientos correctivos

Reverse the duplicate voucher if full duplicate; otherwise create corrective voucher to credit account 7100 by 1350 NOK with matching counter-account adjustment
Filter voucher lines on account 4500 with base amount 21900 NOK lacking VAT line on account 2710

Create corrective voucher adding missing VAT line on account 2710 for 5475 NOK and balancing line to the original counter-account or VAT settlement account per bookkeeping rules, referencing original voucher
Filter voucher lines on account 7300 where 15800 NOK was posted instead of 5850 NOK
Create corrective voucher reducing account 7300 by 9950 NOK and post balancing entry to the original counterpart account, referencing original voucher
Re-run ledger query for January and February 2026 and verify corrected balances and audit trail notes on all four corrections

planned_endpoints.summary: Find vouchers corresponding with sent data.
Reverses the voucher, and returns the reversed voucher. Supports reversing most voucher types, except salary transactions.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: REQUIRES dateFrom and dateTo as query params. Without them you get 422.
dateTo is EXCLUSIVE — if you want vouchers from March 22, use dateTo=2026-03-23 (next day).
NEVER use dateFrom == dateTo — it always returns 422. Always set dateTo = dateFrom + 1 day minimum.
Example for single day: params={"dateFrom": "2026-03-22", "dateTo": "2026-03-23"}
Example for broad range: params={"dateFrom": "2026-01-01", "dateTo": "2026-12-31"}
These are QUERY PARAMS via the params field — NOT json_body.
Method is PUT, not POST.
date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Do NOT send date in the request body.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

Con las herramientas disponibles aquí solo puedo llamar tripletex_request con method/path/json_body, sin campo params. ¿Cuál es la mejor estrategia exacta para consultar los vouchers/postings por rango de fechas y, si es posible, filtrar por cuenta/importe? También necesito la forma exacta del body para POST /ledger/voucher con asientos manuales vatType=0 para: 1) reclasificar 4450 de 6500 a 6540, 2) anular duplicado 1350 en 7100, 3) registrar IVA faltante 5475 en 2710 para base 21900 en 4500, 4) corregir exceso 9950 en 7300. Indica si debo usar /ledger/voucher o /ledger/postingByDate para localizar, y cómo pasar query params dado que la herramienta no expone params.

what_to_try_next: For the duplicate voucher (account 7100, 1350 NOK): create a separate corrective voucher that explicitly reverses the duplicate posting with a debit/credit pair matching the original voucher's date and reference, not just a net adjustment.
Remove the `fields=*` parameter from /ledger/postingByDate calls to avoid the 422 error and save one API call.
Avoid including supplier references in general ledger voucher postings — only include supplier when posting to accounts payable (2400-series); this eliminates the first failed POST attempt.
